### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[A]: When detailing diagnostic reasoning or the relevance of patient history (e.g., comorbidities), only include factors or impacts explicitly stated by the provider. Do not infer additional contributing factors or the potential influence of comorbidities on symptom severity.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: When reporting symptom durations, strictly link each duration to the specific symptom it describes in the transcript; do not extend durations from one symptom to another.
